5Install

  1. Press Copy signature above.
  2. Open Gmail settings → General (or ⚙ → See all settings).
  3. Scroll to Signature, click Create new and name it Elephant Room.
  4. Click in the box and paste (⌘V). The animation shows as a still in the editor; it moves in sent mail.
  5. Under Signature defaults, pick Elephant Room for new emails and for replies/forwards.
  6. Scroll right to the bottom and press Save Changes. Send yourself a test email.
  1. Press Copy Claude install prompt above.
  2. Open Claude with browser access to your logged-in Gmail (Claude in Chrome, or Claude Code with the browser tools).
  3. Paste the prompt. Claude opens Gmail settings, adds the signature, sets it as your default and saves.
  4. Send yourself a test email to check it.

Claude only needs your open Gmail tab. Never give it your password.

  1. Apple Mail: Mail → Settings → Signatures → +, untick “Always match my default message font”, then paste into the right-hand box.
  2. Outlook: Settings → Mail → Compose and reply → Email signature, then paste. Outlook on Windows shows only the first frame of a GIF, which is the finished logo, so it still looks right.
  3. Gmail on your phone: the app's own signature is plain text. Mail sent from your laptop shows the full signature.
